tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Retest of broken structure or sustained continuation to validate the shift in market structure.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish structure with higher highs is being challenged by rejection at 1740 and downward price action toward the recent higher low.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear break below the most recent swing low (~1705-1710) to confirm bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Shooting Star
tracked_patterns.evidence: A candle with a long upper wick extending above 1740 and a small body near the open is visible at the recent high, suggesting intraday rejection.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Follow-through bearish candle(s) closing below the shooting star low to confirm the reversal signal.

tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price wicks extended above the 1740 level followed by rejection, suggesting a stop-hunt or liquidity grab above recent highs.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmation of bearish order flow and follow-through downside after the sweep.

tracked_patterns.name: Ascending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Series of higher lows visible around 1705, 1715, and 1720 approaching a flat resistance zone at 1740-1745.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above the resistance level at 1740-1745.

tracked_patterns.name: Falling Wedge
tracked_patterns.evidence: Post-impulse contraction showing lower highs and higher lows forming converging trendlines
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Decisive close above upper wedge trendline

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Left shoulder formed around 1735, head formed around 1745 (highest wick), and right shoulder currently forming around 1735-1740.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Completion of right shoulder and decisive break below neckline around 1720-1725.
